**Observation Log:**

[SESSION_DATE] 2023/03/20 (Mon) 13:35  
[SESSION_ID] 68396ed3_2  

[USER] User is looking to cancel an Amazon order placed yesterday.  
[USER] User has been using Amazon a lot lately, making around 3 to 4 online purchases a week for the past two months.  

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant is happy to help with canceling the Amazon order but clarifies that it doesn't have direct access to the user's Amazon account or order information.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provides steps to cancel an Amazon order:  
1. Go to Amazon.com and sign in to your account.  
2. Click on "Your Orders" at the top right corner of the page.  
3. Find the order to cancel and click on "Cancel items" next to it.  
4. Follow the prompts to confirm the cancellation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] If unable to cancel online, the user can contact Amazon's customer service by:  
1. Clicking on "Help & Customer Service" at the top right corner of the page.  
2. Selecting "Contact Us" and then "Email Us" or "Call Us".  
3. Providing the order number and explanation for the cancellation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant encourages the user to keep track of orders and ensure they are within budget.  

[USER] User will try to cancel the order themselves and thanks the assistant for the steps.  
[USER] User asks for recommendations on good cashback credit cards suitable for online shopping, considering their purchase frequency.  

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant lists several cashback credit cards:  
1. **Amazon Prime Rewards Visa Signature Card**: 5% cashback on Amazon purchases, 2% at gas stations, restaurants, and drugstores, 1% on all other purchases, and a $70 Amazon gift card upon approval.  
2. **Chase Freedom Unlimited**: 3% cashback on all purchases in the first year up to $20,000 spent, 1.5% on all other purchases, no annual fee, and a $150 bonus after spending $500 in the first 3 months.  
3. **Citi Double Cash Card**: 2% cashback on all purchases (1% when you buy and 1% when you pay).  
4. **Discover it Cash Back**: 5% cashback on rotating categories and 1% on all other purchases, with a dollar-for-dollar match of cashback earned in the first year.  
5. **Capital One Quicksilver Cash Rewards**: 1.5% cashback on all purchases, with a one-time $150 bonus after spending $500 in the first 3 months.  

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advises considering factors when choosing a cashback credit
